record.text: 你的随从的法力值消耗增加（2）点。

record.text:
受伤时拥有+1攻
击力。

face.name: 灼光战斗法师
face.flavorText: 手中的上古热刀专切黄油。

face.name: Blazing Battlemage
face.flavorText: Weaponized an ancient technique once used to slice cold butter.

face.name: 厄运鼹鼠
face.flavorText: 你肯定不想让厄运鼹鼠把洞穴挖的满山都是吧。

face.name: Dire Mole
face.flavorText: You especially don't want to make a dire mountain out of a dire mole hill.

face.name: 疲倦的大一新生
face.flavorText: 三更灯火五更鸡，新生眼皮抬不起。

face.name: Frazzled Freshman
face.flavorText: "Late to bed, early to rise, makes a student unable to open her eyes."

face.name: 赛场观众
face.flavorText: 他之所以如此兴奋，是因为买到了本年度锦标赛的季票。平时季票并不好买，他通常都是花费高价在食人魔票贩子那里收来的。

face.name: Tournament Attendee
face.flavorText: He was so excited to get season tickets to this year's Grand Tournament. He normally doesn't get them at first and has to buy them from Ogre scalpers.

face.name: 盔中寄居蟹
face.flavorText: 绝不容许盔损。

face.name: Helmet Hermit
face.flavorText: I’d avoid asking if it wants to join the battle. It’s been pretty crabby lately.

face.name: 空气元素
face.flavorText: 那种没人在意你的感觉，是永远的痛。

face.name: Air Elemental
face.flavorText: Makes a mean puff pastry.

face.name: 深渊巨蟒
face.flavorText: 打蛇打七寸，可它的七寸在哪里……

face.name: Pit Snake
face.flavorText: It could be worse. It could be a Snake Pit.

face.name: 研究伙伴
face.flavorText: “老师，我的作业被一个侏儒烧掉了！”

face.name: Lab Partner
face.flavorText: "Professor, a gnome burned my homework!"

face.name: 翡翠蜂后
face.text: 你的随从的法力值消耗增加（2）点。
face.flavorText: 伊瑟拉对于蜂后将自己的蜂巢命名为“翡翠梦境”感到怒不可遏，发誓要告到她倾家荡产。

face.name: Emerald Hive Queen
face.flavorText: She rules the emerald hive at the end of the yellow brick trail.

face.name: 战斗机器人
face.text: 受伤时拥有+1攻 击力。
face.flavorText: 战斗机器人的量产计划因为其“样本产品”的体型过大而流产。

face.name: Warbot
face.flavorText: Mass production of warbots was halted when it was discovered that they were accidentally being produced at "sample size."

face.name: 符文蛋
face.flavorText: 符文蛋饼异常美味，鲜香嫩滑回味无穷！

face.name: Runic Egg
face.flavorText: Oh man! Runic omelettes are the best!

face.name: 蜡油元素
face.flavorText: 蜡烛制的武器可以对其造成双倍伤害。

face.name: Wax Elemental
face.flavorText: Takes double damage from wick-based weapons.

face.name: 滑板机器人
face.flavorText: 我的滑板车时尚时尚最时尚。

face.name: Skaterbot
face.flavorText: "See you later bot" - Jaina
